integrity_notes: All-width proof uses exact derivative packet and a sign-pair extremality identity; finite checker supplements rather than replaces proof. Full manuscript of early variance-image implementation was inaccessible; its 2011 submission date is not treated as a verified public-release date.
scientific_limitations: Only full consecutive windows on real open paths; n at least twice window width is required for sharpness statement
Population variance divisor m and a fixed bounded common input range; all-input constant grows with interval width
No finite-pair attainment claim, no sharp short-path constants, no weighted or periodic analogues
title: A sharp parity law for bounded-variation stability of sliding population variance
